## 1. Theoretical Motivation & Methodological Overview

Traditional statistical modeling in social science emphasizes explanatory inference ($p$-values, unbiased parameters). Machine learning prioritizes out-of-sample prediction error minimization on unseen data.

In this workbook, we implement `tidymodels` to compare baseline OLS, regularized LASSO, and ensemble Random Forests.

---

## 2. Environment Setup & Data Pipeline

```{r setup-and-feature-engineering}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(glmnet)
library(vip)

# Load raw OWID dataset and engineer dynamic lag features
owid_raw <- read_csv("../data/life_expectancy_data.csv")

ml_dataset <- owid_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(life_exp), !is.na(code)) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    life_exp_lag1 = lag(life_exp, 1),
    life_exp_lag5 = lag(life_exp, 5),
    life_exp_change_5yr = lag(life_exp, 1) - lag(life_exp, 6)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na(life_exp_lag1, life_exp_lag5, life_exp_change_5yr)
```

---

## 3. Data Partitioning & Cross-Validation Architecture

```{r data-splitting-cv}
set.seed(2026)

# 80/20 Stratified Train/Test Split
data_split <- initial_split(ml_dataset, prop = 0.80, strata = life_exp)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# 5-Fold Cross-Validation Folds
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5, strata = life_exp)
```

---

## 4. Feature Engineering Recipes & Model Specifications

```{r recipe-and-specs}
ml_recipe <- recipe(
  life_exp ~ year + life_exp_lag1 + life_exp_lag5 + life_exp_change_5yr + country,
  data = train_data
) %>%
  step_other(country, threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

ols_spec   <- linear_reg() %>% set_engine("lm") %>% set_mode("regression")
lasso_spec <- linear_reg(penalty = 0.05, mixture = 1) %>% set_engine("glmnet") %>% set_mode("regression")
rf_spec    <- rand_forest(mtry = 3, trees = 500, min_n = 5) %>% set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>% set_mode("regression")

ols_wf   <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(ml_recipe) %>% add_model(ols_spec)
lasso_wf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(ml_recipe) %>% add_model(lasso_spec)
rf_wf    <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(ml_recipe) %>% add_model(rf_spec)
```

---

## 5. Model Training & Cross-Validation Evaluation

```{r cross-validation-execution}
eval_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq, mae)

ols_cv_results   <- fit_resamples(ols_wf, resamples = cv_folds, metrics = eval_metrics)
lasso_cv_results <- fit_resamples(lasso_wf, resamples = cv_folds, metrics = eval_metrics)
rf_cv_results    <- fit_resamples(rf_wf, resamples = cv_folds, metrics = eval_metrics)

cv_summary <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(ols_cv_results) %>% mutate(Model = "OLS Baseline"),
  collect_metrics(lasso_cv_results) %>% mutate(Model = "LASSO Regularized"),
  collect_metrics(rf_cv_results) %>% mutate(Model = "Random Forest")
) %>%
  filter(.metric == "rmse") %>%
  select(Model, Metric = .metric, Mean_RMSE = mean, Std_Error = std_err)
```

---

## 6. Comprehensive Visualizations (5 Figures)

### Figure 1: Out-of-Sample Cross-Validation RMSE Comparison

```{r figure-1-cv-comparison}
ggplot(cv_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, -Mean_RMSE), y = Mean_RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_RMSE - Std_Error, ymax = Mean_RMSE + Std_Error), width = 0.15) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Mean_RMSE, 3)), vjust = -0.8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Cross-Validation RMSE Comparison Across Models",
    x = "Algorithm Architecture",
    y = "Cross-Validation Mean RMSE (Years)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Figure 2: Predicted vs. Actual Life Expectancy

```{r figure-2-predicted-vs-actual}
final_rf_fit <- fit(rf_wf, data = train_data)
test_predictions <- predict(final_rf_fit, test_data) %>% bind_cols(test_data)

ggplot(test_predictions, aes(x = life_exp, y = .pred)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Random Forest Predicted vs. Actual Life Expectancy (Test Set)",
    x = "Actual Observed Life Expectancy (Years)",
    y = "Random Forest Predicted Life Expectancy (Years)"
  )
```

### Figure 3: Residual Error Distribution

```{r figure-3-residual-distribution}
test_predictions <- test_predictions %>% mutate(residual = life_exp - .pred)

ggplot(test_predictions, aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "midnightblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3: Distribution of Out-of-Sample Prediction Residuals",
    x = "Prediction Residual Error (Years)",
    y = "Observation Frequency"
  )
```

### Figure 4: LASSO Coefficient Regularization Trace Path

```{r figure-4-lasso-trace}
lasso_fit <- fit(lasso_wf, data = train_data)
glmnet_obj <- extract_fit_engine(lasso_fit)
plot(glmnet_obj, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
title("Figure 4: LASSO Coefficient Shrinkage Trace Path", line = 2.5)
```

### Figure 5: Random Forest Permutation Variable Importance

```{r figure-5-variable-importance}
final_rf_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  vip(geom = "point", num_features = 10, horizontal = TRUE) +
  aes(color = Importance) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 5: Permutation Variable Importance Spectrum (Random Forest)",
    x = "Predictor Variables",
    y = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
